summary: B2Gold Corp. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release that announces the date and details for its second quarter 2026 earnings release and conference call. The filing provides the earnings release date (August 6, 2026, after market close), the conference call schedule (August 7, 2026), registration and dial-in instructions, and replay access information. It includes standard boilerplate about the company and contact details. There is no mention of any transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation structural mechanics. As this is a routine earnings announcement, it does not constitute a special situation. This filing maps to a U.S. press release announcing earnings results.
